migration_requirements.title: Source-provenance and quarantine migration readiness requirement
migration_requirements.statement: Documentary migration-readiness requirement for source-provenance and quarantine migration readiness requirement. A migration executed is not a business acceptance and is not a source retirement; no migration is performed.
migration_requirements.migration_requirement_basis: Derived from Volume 9 migration and coexistence obligations and the House P0 findings.
migration_requirements.rehearsal_requirement: Requires rehearsed migration in a recovery-exercise environment before any cutover consideration.
migration_requirements.reconciliation_requirement: Requires reconciliation evidence between source and House records.
migration_requirements.rollback_dependency: Requires a rehearsed rollback path; rollback remains a planning concept only.
